[IRET.3.4] **Slot equality with tolerance.** At
fact-assert time, the working memory dedup path compares
the incoming fact against any existing fact with the same
schema and identity-key slot value. For each slot:

- Slots without tolerance: `memcmp` on the 8-byte
  union content (safe for int/float/bool/interned-ptr).
  String slots compare pointer (interned equality).
- Slots with tolerance `T > 0`: only legal on `Int` and
  `Float`; the values are equal when `abs(new - old) <= T`, a
  change of exactly `T` included ([RLOW.3.7.4]).
- `Json` slots: structural deep equality.

If all slots compare equal under their per-slot rule,
the incoming assertion is suppressed (no-op).
